title: A refused upload could be finalised again
symptom: A refused upload (too big or unreadable) could be re-sent to the same path and finalised again, re-running the image decode each time; only successful finalises were counted.
fix: A refused upload is marked done without a photo (finalised_at set, photo_id null); finalising it again answers not_found before any download.

title: No daily cap on guest intake emails from the general invite
symptom: The general link sends E1/E6 to whatever address is typed, bounded only by the per-IP limit, so the daily email budget could be spent on it.
fix: Per general invite, at most 20 guest intake emails a day (requestSendInvite); over it the request is still stored and Jon still gets E2.

title: Other people's attempts could refuse the admin's correct sign-in code
symptom: The per-address verify bucket counted every attempt, so 10 tries at the admin's address from anywhere refused the admin's correct code for an hour.
fix: The per-address bucket counts only wrong codes, after the check; the per-IP limit still counts every attempt.

title: Scrubber missed names and free-text keys, and pg failing-row details
symptom: Keys like contact_name, pitch_idea or before60_answer in Sentry extras/tags passed through, and a check violation's 'Failing row contains (...)' kept the row values.
fix: SENSITIVE also matches name, pitch, need_to_know, answer, plan and detail; scrubText redacts 'Failing row contains (...)'.

title: Siteverify hostname was not checked
symptom: A solve from any site using our key passed.
fix: Outside prototype, siteverify's hostname must equal NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL's host (a mismatch is reported).

title: A chunked beacon body was read whole before the size check
symptom: Without a Content-Length, POST /api/events buffered the entire body before refusing it as over 256 bytes.
fix: The body is read with a bounded reader that stops once it passes the limit.

title: Free/busy refetch had no single flight
symptom: After the 10-minute cache expired, every guest render called Google until one write landed.
fix: The refetch runs under a transaction advisory lock; renders that arrive meanwhile serve the stale cache.

title: A Surprise plan was stored on any dish
symptom: surprisePlan sent with a non-Surprise dish was stored as surprise_plan_sealed, and Jon saw 'Sealed plan on file' on that request.
fix: storableBody drops surprisePlan unless the dish is Surprise Me.
